name: agent-workflows
description: Multi-step task contexts (failing tests, repo maps, profiler and bisect output, app/web task state) where the fix-relevant lines must survive compaction for the task to succeed.
disclaimer: Cases are synthetic and self-authored — not sampled from, or submitted to, any external benchmark. The public benchmarks below are referenced only as task-category analogs so readers can anchor the agent-workflow and coding task; these numbers are not scores on those benchmarks.

related_benchmarks.name: SWE-bench Verified
related_benchmarks.note: Human-validated real-repo bug fixes; the failing-test-plus-traceback-plus-fix-location shape of our coding cases.

related_benchmarks.name: AppWorld
related_benchmarks.note: Interactive multi-app tasks over APIs and state (invoices, calendars); the app-task cases mirror its structured task context.

related_benchmarks.name: WebArena
related_benchmarks.note: Realistic web-navigation tasks where the answer sits in a noisy page context, like our order-history navigation case.
